callback.title: Sign in
callback.error: Signing in didn't work. Try again.

accountDeleted.title: Account deleted
accountDeleted.message: This account was deleted: you have been signed out.

sessionUnavailable.title: Unable to connect
sessionUnavailable.message: The connection couldn't be restored. Try again in a moment.

onboarding.title: Welcome
onboarding.intro: Introduce yourself. Other participants will see your nickname if you choose one, otherwise your first and last name. Your email stays private.

pseudo.length: The nickname must be 3 to 20 characters long.
pseudo.taken: This nickname is already taken. Try another one.
pseudo.invalid: This nickname is not accepted. Try another one.

name.characters: Letters only, in words separated by a space, - or '.
name.invalid: This name isn't accepted. Check its spelling.

pseudoForm.removed: Nickname removed: others see your first and last name.

sportLabel.label: Which sport?
sportLabel.characters: This name has invisible or control characters. Remove them.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.hint: Your ongoing challenges are in several time zones: choose the one of the start time.

startedAt.label: Start
startedAt.required: Enter the start date and time.
startedAt.range: The start cannot be in the future, nor before 2000.

duration.label: Duration
duration.hint: Required, 24 h at most. The speed is computed from the duration and the distance.
duration.invalid: Enter whole numbers: 24 hours at most, minutes and seconds from 0 to 59.
duration.range: Enter a duration between 1 second and 24 hours.
duration.future: The activity must be over: its start plus its duration is past the current time.

distance.label: Distance (km)
distance.hintOptional: Optional: if you enter it, the activity also counts for distance.
distance.range: Enter a distance in km, from 0.001 to 1000, with 3 decimals at most.

states.loadMoreFailed: The next challenges couldn't be loaded.

empty.public: No public challenge yet. Start yours!
empty.mine: You are not in any challenge yet. Create yours or join one.

title.label: Title
title.length: The title must be 3 to 80 characters long.
title.characters: The title contains a character that is not allowed (line break, tab or invisible character).

description.label: Description (optional)
description.length: The description must be 2000 characters at most.
description.characters: The description contains an invisible character that is not allowed.

visibility.label: Visibility
visibility.publicHint: Listed on the home screen: everyone can see it.
visibility.required: Choose who can see the challenge.

membersCanInvite.label: Participants can invite
membersCanInvite.hint: Otherwise, only the challenge creators invite.

weeks.label: Duration (in weeks)
weeks.range: The duration must be a whole number of weeks, from 2 to 52.

startDate.label: Start date
startDate.hint: Today or later, one year ahead at most. The challenge starts at midnight, in the time zone chosen above.
startDate.range: The start date must be between today and the same date next year.

timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.hint: The one of the place you run the challenge from. Weeks start and end there, for every participant.
timezone.required: Choose a time zone from the list.

eliminationStep.label: Increment X (in km)
eliminationStep.hint: More than 0 km, 100 km at most, one decimal at most.
eliminationStep.range: The increment must be from 0.1 to 100 km, with one decimal at most.

factors.label: Distance factors
factors.hint: Suggested by the app; you can change them, from 0.1 to 2. Running always counts {{run}}.
factors.range: The factor must be from 0.1 to 2, with two decimals at most.
factors.waiting: The factors must show before you go on: wait or try again.

fields.serverInvalid: Value refused. Check it, then send the challenge again.

preview.title: Preview
preview.empty: The preview shows once the duration, date and time zone are chosen.

categories.fixed: A challenge always has these 3 categories, each with its podium. You only set the distance factors and the increment X.

time.name: Total time
time.explanation: The total time of all activities, every sport included.

distance.name: Total distance
distance.explanation: The km of distance activities, brought back to a running distance: a km of cycling at ×0.3 counts for 0.3 km.

elimination.name: Running with elimination
elimination.explanation: Running only. Each week, you must run at least the previous week's distance plus X km, or you are eliminated from this category. No elimination in week 1.
elimination.example: Example with X = {{step}}: {{week1}} run in week 1, at least {{week2}} needed in week 2; {{ran2}} run in week 2, at least {{week3}} in week 3.

recap.final: The categories cannot be changed once the challenge is created.

submit.label: Create the challenge
submit.invalid: Some details were refused: {{fields}}. Fix them, then try again.

leave.title: Leave the challenge creation?
leave.message: What you entered is not saved: it will be lost.

categories.title: Categories
categories.frozen: Set at creation, they no longer change.

notFound.title: Challenge not found
notFound.message: This challenge doesn't exist or you don't have access to it.

join.title: Join “{{title}}”?
join.message: Your activities (date, sport, duration, distance) will be visible to the other participants of the challenge.
join.closed: Registration closed at the end of week 1, on {{date}}.
join.closed_zone: Registration closed at the end of week 1, on {{date}}, {{zone}}.
join.participant: You are taking part in this challenge.
join.abandoned: You abandoned this challenge: it's final, you can't join it again.

abandon.title: Abandon “{{title}}”?
abandon.message: This is final: you are eliminated from all 3 categories and shown as “Abandoned” in the leaderboards, off the podium. You won't be able to join this challenge again.

edit.heading: Edit the challenge
edit.frozen: Dates, visibility and categories are set at creation: they no longer change. Only the title and description can be edited.
edit.descriptionHint: 2000 characters at most. Left empty, it is removed from the challenge.
edit.serverInvalid: Value refused. Check it, then try again.

participants.label: Challenge participants
participants.empty: No one has joined this challenge yet.

leaderboard.label: Challenge leaderboard
leaderboard.empty: No one is ranked in this challenge yet.
leaderboard.final: Final results: the challenge ended on {{date}}
leaderboard.final_zone: Final results: the challenge ended on {{date}}, {{zone}}

elimination.firstWeek: No elimination in week 1: the first minimum applies in week 2.
elimination.rule: Next week's minimum = your distance this week + {{step}}. Run more than the minimum and your distance becomes the new base.
